recommendedTextbook.title: Comprehensive Economics for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: J. U. Anyaele
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

subtopics: Gross Domestic Product (GDP) vs Gross National Product (GNP)
Measurement methods: Output, income, and expenditure approaches
Challenges of national income computation in Nigeria
objectives: Define GDP, GNP, NNI and per capita income
Calculate GDP using the expenditure approach (C + I + G + (X - M))
Explain how unrecorded informal sector transactions skew national accounts

topics.topic: Money and Central Banking in Nigeria
subtopics: Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN): Statutory functions and monetary policy
Commercial banking and credit creation formula
objectives: Analyze how monetary policy rate (MPR) controls inflation
Calculate money multiplier and bank deposit expansion
Evaluate the role of cashless banking and eNaira

subtopics: Sources of government revenue in Nigeria (oil and non-oil taxes)
Principles of taxation (Adam Smith's canons) and direct vs indirect taxes
Government budget: Balanced, deficit, and surplus budgets
objectives: Distinguish progressive, proportional, and regressive taxation
Analyze economic effects of fiscal deficits and national debt
Evaluate tax evasion and compliance challenges in Nigeria

topics.topic: International Trade and Balance of Payments
subtopics: Absolute and comparative cost advantage theories (David Ricardo)
Terms of trade and balance of payments (current vs capital account)
Trade barriers: Tariffs, quotas, embargoes, and AFCFTA
objectives: Calculate gains from trade based on comparative advantage
Distinguish balance of trade from balance of payments
Examine benefits and challenges of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA)
